title: lms2~
description: `lms2~` implements an adaptive FIR filter using the LMS algorithm, producing the filter output y[n], the error e[n] = d[n] - y[n], and coefficient outputs. Its creation arguments set the number of coefficients and the step-size parameter mu; `lms2~` differs from `lms~` by providing additional outputs for e[n] and c[n].
